name: THE RIFT
description:
About This Game

Every second counts. THE RIFT is a game that blends arcade racing gameplay, realistic physics, and shooting mechanics. Find the best racing lines, beat your best times, and climb the leaderboard.

Campaign

Perfect for challenging the competition. Earn medals and rewards based on your performance. Improve your position on the scoreboards. New maps will be added regularly through updates!

Multiplayer

THE RIFT offers a multi-layered multiplayer mode. Compete with your friends in local hosting or face off against players around the world on public servers.

Editor Mode

Let your creativity run wild and design your own races. This mode expands the overall experience by encouraging collaboration and sharing, with dedicated tools and assets available for players.  Ready to design the race of your dreams and challenge your friends on your own creations?

Personalization

Unlock new ships and components. Take your style to the next level.

Contemplation

Alongside the racing, THE RIFT invites you to slow down with a contemplative mode! Freely explore the arenas and immerse yourself in the game’s landscapes.
short_desc: Race through colossal arenas in full 6DOF with insane speeds, shoot mechanics, and gravity-defying stunts.
